# obsidian-second-brain Agent Skills

- Upstream: https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain
- Release: `v0.17.0`
- Commit: `87fe5437c44fffafb5188566d458891651536d4e`
- Build: `bash scripts/build.sh --platform agent-skills`
- Installed output: `.agents/skills/`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.

The upstream project provides 47 Agent Skills, including vault capture/search/maintenance and software-project architecture, task, decision, and log workflows. Generated output is checked in so Codex discovers the skills immediately after checkout; `scripts/install-second-brain.sh` reproduces that tree from the pinned commit.
